title: 3 Role Definition: auditor + readonly + role binding
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: auditor.md 包含完整角色 spec (inherits readonly, grants [audit.export, instance.read, log.read])
AC-2: readonly.md 限制只能读 *.read 动作, 明确定义拒绝写的场景
AC-3: role-binding.md 包含 role ↔ user/group 绑定 schema (role, subject_type, subject_id, granted_by, expires_at)
AC-4: role-loader.ts 运行时 load + validate (set -euo pipefail, fail-closed, try/catch e:unknown)
AC-5: permissions-schema.ts 包含 KALLAX-permission.json schema (roles, scope_bindings, action_grants)
AC-6: kallax role:list CLI 列出所有 roles
AC-7: kallax role:whoami 显示当前 role + permissions
AC-8: kallax role:check <action> 验证当前 role 是否有权执行 action
AC-9: L1 存在性: ls src/permissions/roles/ 返回 auditor.md + readonly.md + role-binding.md
AC-10: L2 实质性: wc -c 每个 .md 文件 > 500 bytes
AC-11: L3 接线正确: npx tsc --noEmit -p node/tsconfig.json 无错误
AC-12: L4 数据流动: bash scripts/verify/security.sh + bash scripts/verify/architecture.sh 全 PASS
p0_fixes: fail-closed: 任何 authz 错误 exit 1 deny
set -euo pipefail on all bash scripts
role 名称 validation (防 trailing space, typo)
